SINGLE.name: Single Definition
SINGLE.headline: Fully connected energy — the most stable
SINGLE.body: All your defined centers connect into one whole. That means your energy is more stable and consistent than any other definition type. You don't need others to feel energetically complete — you can work solo and decide solo.

SPLIT.name: Split Definition
SPLIT.headline: Two energy parts, bridged by others
SPLIT.body: Your energy is divided into two parts that don't connect to each other. On your own, the parts operate separately. Around someone who has the bridging gate, you feel more whole. Worth noticing — this isn't a deficit, it's how you draw people into your life.

TRIPLE_SPLIT.name: Triple Split Definition
TRIPLE_SPLIT.headline: Three energy parts, takes longer to integrate
TRIPLE_SPLIT.body: Your energy is divided into three groups that don't connect — rarer, and it takes longer to resolve. Group environments where varied energies bridge you suit you well. Solo work is fine, but your processing may take longer.

QUAD_SPLIT.name: Quad Split Definition
QUAD_SPLIT.headline: Four parts — the most complex, the rarest
QUAD_SPLIT.body: Four separate energy groups — the rarest combination. Be more patient with yourself when making decisions. The energy of others helps bridge, but you also need solo time to integrate what's coming in.

NONE.name: No Definition
NONE.headline: Reflector — all centers open
NONE.body: As a Reflector, all 9 of your centers are open — no center is fixed-defined. That's what makes you a mirror of the environment. You take in the energy around you and reflect it back. It's a unique strength no other type has.
